d:
In an unprecedented development outside the Delhi Police Headquarters (PHQ), personnel and officers of the Delhi Police staged a demonstration against the transfer of ACP Manasvi Vashishta and Shahdara SHO Inspector Arun Kumar. The unilateral transfers followed a strike by Delhi district court lawyers, who alleged that the ACP brandished a service weapon during a scuffle at the Shahdara police station arising from an assault case involving advocate
